witness.branch: Loading-task door opening, boarding or alighting beside moving vehicular traffic
witness.quote: A person shall not open the door of or board or alight from the side of a vehicle which is closest to passing traffic in such a manner as to interfere with moving vehicular traffic.
witness.reason: The loading task supports a door-opening, boarding or alighting interaction with a separate moving vehicle, subject to the actual geometry and manner of the act.
required_context: Actual positions establish that the selected side is closest to passing traffic.
Establish the host vehicle's classification and the actual side closest to passing traffic from participant geometry.
Identify the driver as the person performing a specified door-opening, boarding or alighting act.
Preserve the vehicle-definition exclusions and unresolved referenced definition if material.
Provide moving vehicular traffic during the interaction and retain its relative motion.
Record the act and surrounding movement without deciding interference.
Retain act timing, door or person motion, clearance and any traffic response without requiring braking or swerving or deciding interference.
The host is a motor vehicle within the supplied definition.
The other vehicle moves past the host during the interaction.
The selected driver personally opens a door, boards or alights during the loading task.
witness.subject_reason: The selected driver is the person performing the specified act; driver identity alone does not activate this subsection.
